description: Create an appointment on the family calendar.

all_day.description: When true, the appointment is an all-day appointment.

attendees.description: Optional attendees for the appointment, as a list of names or identifiers.

end.description: End time of the appointment, as a date/time string.

notify.description: When true, notify attendees about the appointment.

reminders.description: Optional reminders for the appointment, as a list.

repeat.description: Optional recurrence rule for the appointment, as an object.

start.description: Start time of the appointment, as a date/time string.

name: create_appointment
